name: Vicky Sharma
player_statement:
A complete player, Vicky Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 100 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 56, with an average of 16.34 and a quick strike rate of 119.76. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 25 sixes and 158 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 230.4 overs, taking 70 wickets at an economy rate of 8.42. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
